name: stance-retreat-heal
description: retreat when damaged, to a place of healing: four rangers with retreat at 70% are hurt to 40%; they go into the heal building, are healed, come out and go back to where they stood. The heal building is looked up by KindOf (@HEAL_PAD: a structure of the America side if the data has one, else of any side, such as a civilian hospital); the trace names it on the line "ASSISTTEST created 1 x ...". "cannot create @HEAL_PAD": the data has no such structure. "cannot use facility" or "goes to the rally point": the building does not take infantry in. (Needs the commits with MSG_ASSIST_STANCE; until then "this build has no command".)
steps: until not atsnapshot rangers tol=60 max=300
log: ^ASSIST stance set mask=2 value=2 percent=70 for 4 units

log.match: ^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ at 40% goes to heal facility \d+
^ASSIST stance retreat: unit \d+ goes back to -?\d+,-?\d+ at 100%
